batch: The Serpent’s Spine – Ashengate East and West
coverage_limits: Development setup included native GM leveling to 74 for one attendance fixture, supported public travel staging, and one scoped reset of prior Vergalid lockouts. Combat used fixture invulnerability and the existing QA melee mallet. Invulnerability was briefly removed for the real Mark self-click and restored before re-entry. This run establishes progression and reward behavior with those aids. Normal raid difficulty remains unmeasured.
Real loot was sampled from all six event sources. Optional loot outcomes, natural expiry of the full 108-hour lockouts, and exhaustive expedition reset and inherited-state paths remain untested.
The original Attendant glow effect, reported chest trap difficulty, and exact historical lava tick remain unresolved. The native route verified the implemented order, thresholds and progression.
historical_reconstruction: Raid-in uses the rounded-up 85 percent rule against the assigned roster. Independently eligible characters include the later level-74 attendance allowance. The original arithmetic details were unavailable.

The six-hour expedition lifetime, some NPC appearances and placements, room boundaries, some wave cadences, the 12-add Ambersnout threshold, 135-second Sothgar pauses, and optional loot chances are reconstructed. The relocated egg and brood route use reachable under-bridge floor.
Stitch’s exact positive faction delta was unavailable. The configured value is +1500, with native faction awarded through the stock hate list.
native_verification: Both public faction cycles and both personal Vergalid’s End side tasks were completed in RoF2. The original Incubator hatched and captured drakes, the four-item hand-in passed, and Jenray’s normal Hail key was verified.

All seven entered Ashengate West, including a level-70 character through the six-of-seven raid-in allowance. The raid earned Ambersnout, Attendants of Sothgar and Sothgar credits and lockouts, recovered real loot, and finished Ghosts from the Past.

The level-70 witness earned Scholars of Solusek faction from Sothgar and looted a genuine one-charge Mark of Vergalid. Holding it left five-of-six re-entry denied. The native self-click spent the charge and awarded durable kill equivalence, which admitted the witness to the same West instance. The witness had no Vergalid’s End completion before or after.

All six entered East, defeated Ayna’Rym and both griffons, completed the timed Ambush through Krait, and defeated Stitch after the spider threshold. All six earned each event credit and lockout. A Complex Diversion archived after its three discoveries, ten Scarlet Legion kills and Stitch. Ayna’Rym’s corpse and both original East chests yielded genuine loot.
